timeline.body:
The test clients receiveNoWait is entirely local, so this is very likely to return null even if the broker does somehow send the consumer a message, likely making this branch and most of the potential loops never happen.

The test already has a proxy for the expiry queue, so perhaps just use a wait check that it goes to 0 after rejecting instead of the loops?
